name: Cervantes / Elena · steps beside the ramp
trust: Three shallow steps on the north half of the lane, beside the smooth ramp, starting one tile row up from the foot drain (IMG_2286, IMG_2355, IMG_2328, IMG_2262). White-painted risers, terracotta treads with grey stone nosings. Risers at 0.4, 0.92 and 1.45 m from the drain: each tread is one 0.4 m tile plus its nosing, about 0.5 m, counted from the tiles in IMG_2286 and IMG_2355. Together they climb the same 0.5 m as the ramp, which reaches the top tread's level 3.0 m up; every tread stays above the ramp beside it (check_terrain.py). Positions approximate (about 0.1 m); the top tread's length to where the ramp meets it is estimated.
